claim_text: Official LGFV exit does not by itself identify institutional exit.
limitations: The assembled sample is not a probability sample and official national counts are not directly re-estimated.

claim_text: Four institutional fates can be coded transparently from formal-event and continued-function evidence.
scope: 94 Codex source-packet working-reference cases pending independent human confirmation
limitations: No liquidation case is present; independent inter-coder agreement has not been reported.

claim_text: The current reference file contains 2 substantive exits, 82 nominal exits, and 10 functional transfers.
limitations: The distribution is sample-specific and is not a national prevalence estimate.

claim_text: Historical capacity is positively associated with movement away from nominal exit in simple specifications.
limitations: The sample has 12 institutional-change events, is nonrepresentative, and both historical-only diagnostic intervals include zero; no stable adjusted or causal estimate is supported.

claim_text: Historical capacity has a stable adjusted association with institutional change.
limitations: After rank repair, the design still has 12 events across eight columns, excludes six low-capacity nominal exits, and changes sign in 9 LPM and 11 Firth leave-one-out runs.

claim_text: The current one-sided LLM rule is a high-precision screen for nominal exit.
limitations: The observed overlap is selected after screening and does not identify target-population precision, recall, calibration, or multiclass error.

claim_text: The paper adapts established concerns about formal-substantive decoupling and LGFV transformation to an auditable case-level framework that combines a documented formal event with post-event tracing of the financing and project function and assigns one of four institutional fates.
scope: verified English- and Chinese-language sources in a bounded search
limitations: The claim concerns the joint evidence design, not priority for the formal-substantive distinction, transformation typologies, codebooks, or human-machine validation; the search is not exhaustive.

claim_text: Historical elite density is associated with movement away from nominal exit in simple specifications. Qualitative evidence is consistent with three possible contemporary processes---fiscal absorption, bureaucratic coordination, and project or state-asset governance---but the present design does not identify these mechanisms or establish historical persistence.
scope: historically matched working-reference cases and verified external process literature
limitations: The proxy also predicts modern education and social capital. Process indicators are not independently coded, temporally ordered, or separated from fiscal resources, province, and document availability.

claim_text: The one-sided nominal screen matches the reference nominal label for 61 of 61 post-hoc overlap issuers.
limitations: This is selected-overlap concordance, not a probability-sample estimate of precision. Recall, calibration, four-category error, and sampling error are unidentified.

claim_text: On 10 September 2026 the author reported that all 94 existing reference labels had been checked by a human and required no revisions.
scope: Exact 94-case reference snapshot identified by the confirmation report; updates the pending-check scope of C-002
limitations: Author-reported completion; reviewer identity and actual review date are unreported. No blinded independent decisions or signatures were supplied; no intercoder statistic or probability-validation claim follows.

claim_text: The source-verified candidate validation frame contains 67 eligible issuer units: 57 screened positive and 10 without a directly documented formal event; the existing allocation proposes a census within this assembled frame.
scope: 133 reviewed issuers reduced to 67 city-platform-scope candidates; 24 proposed strata
limitations: Scope eligibility does not establish exit-case eligibility. The original proposal remains preserved; a census requires actual human outcomes and does not identify national prevalence.

claim_text: A finite-frame residual-correction estimator with fixed predictions and known positive selection probabilities recovers the declared frame mean and fixed-X linear projection in design expectation.
scope: Prespecified finite analytical frame with complete selected responses and fixed auxiliary predictions
limitations: The manuscript derives a finite-population special case; implementation is subject to exhaustive verification before acceptance. No current-frame numerical DSL result or cross-fitting guarantee is asserted.

claim_text: Conditional on the 61 linked human-checked reference outcomes being correct and applicable to their corresponding screen issuer/event, nominal membership among the 158 documentary-screen issuers lies between 38.61 and 100 percent.
scope: Finite 158-issuer documentary screen; 61 positive linked reference outcomes and 97 unknown outcomes
limitations: These are identification bounds rather than confidence intervals. Event/time applicability is an assumption; without it the bounds are 0 to 100 percent. Scope exclusions and no-event screens are not negative exit outcomes.

claim_text: The 67-unit collection package has no exact issuer/event match to the 94-case human-check report and contains no completed human outcome records.
scope: Current source-linked collection package; 6298 unit-reference comparisons
limitations: The 33 historical-capacity links are geographic covariate matches rather than reusable outcome labels. The human-check report does not cover these new units; actual validation remains incomplete.

claim_text: The implemented finite-frame mean and fixed-X projection reproduce the declared design expectations and supported covariance formulas across 717 exhaustive artificial population-selection combinations.
scope: Synthetic verification of the fixed-prediction special case described in C-012
limitations: Mathematical and software verification is complete for the tested contract; actual LGFV validation responses remain absent. Neither external-record authenticity nor a general cross-fitted DSL guarantee follows from passing tests.
